name: laid_back
character: A backbeat behind the beat: the snare sits late and a little louder, the hi-hat a hair early and softer, the kick still the anchor. The feel of a drummer playing behind a steady pulse.

provenance.direction: Câmara et al. 2020b and 'There's More to Timing than Time' (Music Perception 2024): laid-back strokes are later and louder than on-the-beat ones.
provenance.ms: starting value: the direction is measured, the exact offset is not; keep the rhythm section inside the 10 ms groove bound
